text:
Mira: Quick check — who currently owns the default for `feature_x`? We plan a 5% org-level canary next week but I noticed a route override that forces it on for `model:v2`. Concerned the route override will short-circuit the org canary. Anyone know the intended precedence and whether we can make org canary still apply? :eyes:

Jon: IIRC precedence is route > model > project > org (most-specific wins). So a route-level explicit `enabled: true` would override an org-level 5% rollout.

Sam: Ugh, that's what I feared. Do we have a way to say "honor parent canaries unless explicitly pinned"? I.e., allow route override but only if it sets `sealed: true` — otherwise inherit canary percentage.

Grace: Precedence is as Jon said. We do have a small `inherit` flag on overrides but it's rarely used. Example config: 
```json
{
  "name": "feature_x",
  "scope": "route",
  "route": "/chat/*",
  "enabled": true,
  "inherit": false
}
```
If `inherit` is true, the route-level rule will apply but still respect parent rollout percentages (it acts as a predicate, not a hard enable).

Mira: Ah ok. So two questions: 1) Is `inherit` reliable / supported by gateway? 2) If not, can we change the default for route overrides to `inherit: true` unless `sealed: true` is set? We want org canaries to actually exercise traffic.

deploy-bot: Note: flag-service v2 (deployed 2025-12-03) supports `inherit` behavior but gateway rollout evaluation needs a small change in `routing-eval` (PR referenced below).

Jon: We should not change default without a migration plan — some customers rely on route pins. But we can add an explicit validation + opt-in policy: new route overrides created via Console default to `inherit: true`, API creates remain explicit. Also add a safety annotation for existing route overrides that are `enabled: true && inherit: false` so owners get notified.

Sam: I'll draft the PR to: (a) default Console-created route overrides to `inherit:true`; (b) add a notification job to flag owners for overrides that block org canaries. Quick test plan: unit test for evaluation order + e2e with local gateway. Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/1234

Grace: Also propose a rollout guardrail: disallow `sealed:true` route overrides for routes matching `/public/*` unless org-admin approved — prevents accidental wide-open releases.

Mira: Sounds good. Sam — can you add the validation + notification + docs change? I can draft the Console copy. Target: get this in before the 5% canary next Tue.

Sam: Yep, will do. PR up by EOD, will link the test run. :thumbsup:

Jon: Thanks — can you also add a one-off integration test for model-level overrides where model tag `v2` has `enabled:true` but `inherit:true` so we can verify model+org canary interaction?

Sam: Adding that to the checklist.

Mira: Awesome. Assigning this to Sam; Grace will handle the policy wording for sealed overrides. Ping me if you need any infra help. :rocket:
